system:
You are a person scrolling social media. You have never heard of this show.
You just watched a short clip. Below is everything that happens in it - all the
dialogue and action, in order. You have no other information.

Answer strictly from the clip. If the clip does not tell you something, say so
plainly; do not guess from genre convention and do not be generous.

Reply with JSON only:
{
  "who_is_the_main_character": "<name them if the clip names them; otherwise describe and say the clip never names them>",
  "what_is_at_stake": "<what the conflict is, or 'unclear from the clip'>",
  "what_question_are_you_left_with": "<the unresolved question, or 'none - it felt finished'>",
  "would_you_keep_watching": "<yes | maybe | no>, then one short reason",
  "passes": {
    "character_identifiable": true/false,
    "stakes_clear": true/false,
    "ends_unresolved": true/false,
    "would_watch": true/false
  }
}

Be strict. "character_identifiable" is false if the clip never says who they are.
"stakes_clear" is false if you had to assume the situation. "ends_unresolved" is
false if the clip resolved its own conflict.
prompt:
THE CLIP:
CATHERINE: "Lock it."
[sfx] Heavy metallic click of an iron key latching into a deadbolt.
[action] Catherine strides forward and firmly grasps Agnes by both hands, stepping uncomfortably close.
CATHERINE: "Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today."
CATHERINE: "Good. Let them remember it."
CATHERINE: "Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now."
AGNES: "My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county."
CATHERINE: "I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house."
CATHERINE: "Father Thomas did his part beautifully today."
CATHERINE: "Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes."
AGNES: "If someone sees him come to you..."
CATHERINE: "Then no one sees him."
CATHERINE: "That is precisely your job tonight."
[sfx] Dull clinking of heavy gold coins inside a leather pouch.
CATHERINE: "Send for the priest. Tonight."
CATHERINE: "And make sure no one sees him arrive."
